judged_rule: every run is published: Code quality is the equal mean of both judges, except low granarycore, which is scored from Muse Spark 1.3 alone because Grok 4.6's primary review of it has no valid response
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator and its 9 points move to the reviewed score for that submission (intent_recovery_redistributed); 0 GPT-6.2 Sol runs needed it
one_panel_rule: one_panel_note marks the one run scored from a single judge: Grok 4.6's primary review of low granarycore quoted code the submission does not contain on both attempts and was marked invalid under invalidate_unrecoverable_primary (owner precedent 2026-09-23); scored_panels lists the judges that count for each run
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.estimated_usd: API-equivalent at the published list rates, stamped by the sweep at run time and recomputed from the Codex receipt with cached input at the cache-read rate

token_fields.raw_tokens: Codex raw total: input (cached included) plus output
token_fields.token_usage.reasoning_output_tokens: the part of output Codex reports as reasoning

codex_notice_rule: codex_notices lists Codex's own warnings in the run's event stream; no GPT-6.2 Sol run printed one
model_identity: requested-only: Codex does not report the serving model, so identity is the model requested (gpt-6.2-sol)

rows.one_panel_note: published from Muse Spark 1.3 alone: Grok 4.6's primary review has no valid response (both attempts quoted code the submission does not contain), so the v3.31 summary scores the reviewed layer and intent recovery from Muse only, as it does for any submission without two valid reviews

grok.invalid: primary review has no valid response (invalidate_unrecoverable_primary); intent probe not counted
